source_pattern_name_zh: 材料/化学/纳米体系的性质与谱图归属
activation_signals: The problem contains XRD data / an optical-propagation description / a molecular descriptor (Böttcher, Geary) / a liquid-crystal design goal.
The answer is phase + space group + lattice constants, a Yes/No verdict, or an exact decimal.
Symmetry-driven properties (non-linear optics, SPDC, spontaneous polarization) need to be decided.
problem_signatures: 题干经常给一段实验数据（XRD 谱、光束传播、分子结构描述符）或一个设计目标，要求单一判断或精细数值。
常见关键字：XRD, liquid crystal, SPDC, Laguerre-Gaussian, Böttcher complexity, Geary autocorrelation。
答案是相判定 + 空间群 + 晶格常数 / Yes-No / 精确数值。
likely_failure_modes: For spectra, using only the strongest peak instead of the full fingerprint pattern.
Ignoring hard symmetry constraints (centrosymmetric material ⇒ χ^{(2)} forbidden).
For descriptor computations (Böttcher / Geary), estimating from memory instead of evaluating the definition term by term.

sop_phases.title: Phase 1 — Digest Experimental / Design Input
steps: Reduce the data into a standardized parameter table (2θ peaks, beam mode, SMILES / bond graph, phase-transition window).
List the hard physical / chemical constraints of the system (symmetry / bond valence / coordination / thermal window / solvent compatibility).
Identify the answer type (phase assignment / Yes-No / exact number).

sop_phases.title: Phase 2 — Hard-Constraint Filtering
steps: XRD: fingerprint via peak positions + intensity pattern, not the strongest peak alone.
Non-linear optics / SPDC: centrosymmetric ⇒ χ^{(2)} forbidden; check the point group.
Liquid-crystal design: rigid core + tail of adequate length + polar head, placing the phase transition around room temperature.

sop_phases.title: Phase 3 — Quantify Descriptor / Identify Phase
steps: XRD: provide phase + space group + a / b / c / β as a full tuple.
Böttcher molecular complexity: evaluate C = Σ d_i × e_i × s_i × … atom by atom from the definition.
Geary autocorrelation: pick the lag i_max, then take the weighted sum (Sanderson electronegativity).

sop_phases.title: Phase 4 — Literature-Parity Cross-Check & Output
steps: Compare against published values for analogous systems; if the deviation is large, return to Phase 3.
For Yes/No questions, state the physical / chemical reason explicitly before emitting the verdict.
Follow the problem's precision and unit convention ("a = 4.7 Å", "55.51").

subtype_playbook: **XRD phase identification**: fingerprint by 2θ peak positions + intensity ratios; monoclinic reports β, cubic reports only a.
**SPDC / non-linear optics**: centrosymmetric ⇒ χ^{(2)} forbidden; boron-nanosheet symmetry group decides the answer.
**Laguerre-Gaussian beams in random media**: distinguish polarization dephasing from mode decoherence.
**Böttcher complexity**: sum atom by atom strictly from the original definition.
**Geary autocorrelation (MATS / GATS)**: pick lag, then apply the weighted sum.
**Liquid-crystal molecular design**: three-part template — rigid core + flexible tail + polar head.
output_rules: XRD answers follow the example format ("Monoclinic CuO C2/c sp.gr. a = 4.7 Å …").
Yes/No answers use the exact wording the problem asks for.
Descriptor precision follows the problem's example.
